why: Reproduced by driving _gate-suite.html?state=timeline.owner-flight&layout=across at 1024/1280/1440/1920. Below the axis the .b-date top is 751.9 for the one-line titles (Send the invitations, Venue walk-through) and 774.4 for the two-line one (Choose the evening music) at 1440 and 1920 - a 22.5px step, and the identical 22.5px step at 1024/1280 (847.9 vs 870.4). Above the axis every .b-date top is 623 at 1440/1920 including the two-line Menu tasting, so the asymmetry is exactly as described: .b-copy is bottom-anchored above and top-anchored below, and only the top-anchored side lets a wrapped title push its date down a line.
sharpenedFix: The seat is right about the fault and wrong about the fix in two ways, both measured. (1) Its display:flex on .b-title destroys the horizontal centring the across measure depends on: with flex-direction row the anonymous text item shrinks to max-content and justify-content defaults to flex-start, so text-align:center becomes a no-op. Injected at 1440 it moved Wedding day from left 1235.6 to 1158 (-77.6px off its mark), Final guest numbers -16.4px, Venue walk-through -16.8px, Send the invitations -18.2px - every single-line label knocked off the tick it names. (2) Its claim that above the axis nothing moves is true of the glyphs but its stated cost is false: placeAcross already derives --step from the TALLEST .b-copy, so no extra leading is reserved either way. Use instead the one below-scoped declaration, no flex: [data-app="timeline"] .b-measure[data-across="true"] .b-item[data-side="below"] .b-title { min-height: calc(2 * var(--lead-body) * var(--size-body)); }. Injected and measured: below dates all land on 774.4 at 1440/1920 and 870.4 at 1280, above side byte-identical, every glyph box left/right unchanged, --step stays 96px, --rule-y stays 122px, measure height stays 244px. Note the 2-line constant is fixture-bound: a title that ever wraps to three lines re-opens the step. The general form is for placeAcross to clear and re-measure a --title-h (max rendered .b-title height) in the pass it already runs over .b-away and .b-copy, and use min-height: var(--title-h); it must reset the property before measuring or the min-height becomes self-sticky.
